paragraphs.text: Neriv is the Mythic Spirit Dragon of the Mardu Horde on Tarkir , and the living banner around which they rally. He came into being after Narset performed the Stormnexus Ritual and Zurgo called him forth.

Kolaghan had razed the land, the people had suffered many casualties, and there was no community among the brood. In summoning Neriv, the Mardu sought to revitalize their collective, finding power not in the constant pursuit of battle but in their unity and strength of will.

Neriv's primary role is as the marshal of the Mardu, leading them into battle against the other clans and anyone else that stands in their way. He loves to be on the frontlines, preferring not to attack from the sky but joining the Mardu troops on the battlefield.

Neriv's scales are streaked with lightning, and thunder trails in his wake. He flies into battle with fervor and ferocity but will lead a retreat if it means the survival of his troops. Neriv can be easily caught in the heat and passion of a moment, rushing into action before all options are considered. However, the wellbeing of the whole is of high importance to him, helping those who are struggling and building up further those who are already excelling. Neriv works closely with the people of the Mardu and is often an active participant in their daily lives, seen around camps when not scouting the skies.
